# madebydia.com

> Diana Park — software engineer turned stay-at-home mom, building curriculum, open-source tools, and software for real family life.

madebydia.com is a concise identity and domain landing page.

## Build With Your Kid

- [Curriculum](https://buildwithyourkid.com/12-weeks/): Twelve weeks of hands-on tech projects for parents and children ages 2–6.
- [Shop](https://shop.buildwithyourkid.com): Build With Your Kid books and resources.
